name: io.github.IlyaIvanchikov/weeek-mcp-smart
title: WEEEK (smart)
description: WEEEK tasks by name, not IDs — an MCP server

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: WEEEK personal API token (WEEEK → Settings → API)

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override API base for self-hosted / regional hosts (default https://api.weeek.net/public/v1)

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_ATTACH_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory weeek_attach_file may read from (default: the server's working directory)

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_ATTACH_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Max attachable file size in bytes (default 10485760)
